pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented interstitial lines. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. Pixel thickness is consistent across the mid-flank, maintaining a high contrast boundary between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck, created by short, upright mane hairs against the low-contrast background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear feature is visible in the center of the flank, though it appears consistent with a physiological skin fold or lighting shadow rather than an acquired scar.
